Hi Jordan / Priya,

Thanks for the clear request — we can provide the exports and custody attestation. High-level plan we propose: 
1) Export scope: app request logs, API gateway logs, auth events, and the matched indexes you request.
2) Format: gzipped CSV for logs + a JSON manifest with file-level SHA256 hashes.
3) Residency & storage: exports will be staged in an S3 bucket that is restricted to the us-east-1 region; access can be scoped to a short-lived pre-signed URL and a temporary role for your forensics engineer.
4) Retention window: default 90 days from export completion; extensions possible with signed attestation.
5) Chain-of-custody: we will produce an evidence_manifest.csv and an export_readme.txt describing collection time, queries, and hash algorithm.

Action items for you: please confirm the exact user IDs (acct-XXXXXX list) and approve the 90-day retention. Also confirm who will be the named recipient for the custody handoff (full name + corporate email).

Looping in Karthik (Legal) and Marissa (Infra/Ops) to confirm export mechanics and any legal redaction requirements. I attached our standard Forensics Request Form back for tracking.

Best,

Hi all,

Legal quick note on requirements before export: 
- Principle of least privilege: only export fields required for the investigation. If PII (PHI) is present, please provide a redacted dataset or a minimized export with a mapping kept only by Redwood.
- Residency: exports must remain in the US region per Acme's request; any transfer outside requires an explicit signed amendment to the DPA.
- Retention: 90 days is acceptable as a baseline for the investigation. For longer retention, we need a signed addendum specifying retention length and business purpose.
- Evidence attestation: we require a signed custody transfer receipt (DocuSign link below) acknowledging chain-of-custody and controls.

Jordan / Priya: please sign the DPA amendment and the custody receipt. I will not be able to approve exports containing unredacted PHI without the amendment.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/recipient/12345-forensics-dpa-amendment

Karthik
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

Confirming operational details and timeline. Per the above: 
- Export timeframe: will run the export job on 2028-06-24 00:00 UTC to minimize live-service impact.
- Storage & access: objects will be placed in s3://redwood-acme-forensics/us-east-1/incident-20280622/ with bucket policy restricting access to the temporary role assigned to Acme's named recipient.
- File format & integrity: gzipped CSV files + evidence_manifest.csv; all files signed with SHA256; manifest will include file size, record counts, and SHA256.

Attachments we will include with the export: evidence_manifest.csv, export_readme.txt (collection steps + query snapshots). Please reply with the recipient's full name and email and confirm acceptance of the 90-day retention.
